data.acceptance: Agent/hive runtime state distinguishes permission-waiting and waiting-for-queen from idle, running, completed, failed, and terminated. allComplete and equivalent watcher/status paths cannot declare a hive successful while any worker is waiting on a permission decision or queen response. Permission request creation, queen routing, deny/redirect/approve/halt, timeout, and terminal paths transition out of waiting exactly once. Statusboard/agent_list/hive_status expose the waiting state without spam. Tests cover blocked worker not counted complete, queen decision clears waiting, and timeout/escalation behavior.
